rationale: Pass-1 in-file BFS legitimately resolves exact matches at confidence 1.0. Pass 3 (the GUESS tier) fires only when NO ancestor declares the method in-file: here AbstractRenderer does not define draw(), so the edge to it is a per-file guess at the true declaring parent and must carry confidence < 0.7 (patterns.ts consumer threshold). Guesses at 1.0 contaminated thresholded analysis identically to verified overrides.
